problem:
Let
$Y=[\begin{aligned}\sqrt{2} & -1 & 0\end{aligned}]$
and
$U=[\begin{aligned}-4 \\ 0 \\ \sqrt{3}\end{aligned}].$
What are the dimensions of $YU?$
worked_solution:
We notice that $Y$ is a $1\times 3$ matrix and $U$ is a $3\times 1$ matrix. 

There are $3$ columns in $Y$ and $3$ rows in $U.$ Since the number of columns in $Y$ equals the number of rows in $U,$ the matrices $Y$ and $U$ are conformable for multiplication. 

The product $YU$ has dimensions $1\times 1:$

$$
{Y}_{1\times \boxed{\text{3}}}{\times }_{✓}{U}_{\boxed{\text{3}}\times 1}={YU}_{1\times 1}
$$
